f_map.description: Odd linear map f: g -> g; f(Z_domain) = sum_image phi_{image}_{domain} * Z_image, where p(Z_image) != p(Z_domain)
f_map.parity_rule: f(even) -> odd subspace;  f(odd) -> even subspace

metadata.notes: Symbolic output: each (X,Y,Z) entry gives the rational linear form in phi parameters whose value equals (delta_f)(X,Y)^Z. Only non-zero entries stored. phi_{image}_{domain}: coefficient of Z_image in f(Z_domain).
